document.name: Space Club Greenpoint Classes
document.shortDescription: Weekday morning classes in Greenpoint for ages 1-5 with music, art, movement, and sensory play.
document.longDescription:
Space Club's official classes page says its classes are built for children ages 1 to 5 and include music, art, dance and movement, playdoh, and sensory play. The public page shows weekday class times at 10 AM and 11 AM Monday through Friday.

The same official page includes a Greenpoint location block with 220 Newel St, Brooklyn, email greenpoint@spaceclub.com, and phone +1 (212) 812-2996. The published schedule supports a straightforward weekday morning class listing for the Greenpoint neighborhood.

Sources: https://spaceclub.com/pages/classes https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0767/3505/4146/files/SpaceWebsiteClassTiles-02_fb3a5dcc-545a-4d09-8f08-3e9effd7086e.jpg?v=1712857726
